description: All 7 V Rising blood types with quality thresholds, bonuses, stage recommendations, and weapon compatibility. Sourced from in-game testing and community data.

bloodTypes.name: Brute

60.bonus: Attack speed +15%, life leech 7%, +10% max health

90.bonus: Attack speed +25%, life leech 10%, +15% max health

bloodTypes.bonusSummary: Attack speed steroid + life leech + max health

recommendedUsage.earlyGame: Best early game blood — survivability from life leech is unmatched for new players
recommendedUsage.midGame: Pairs with Greatsword and Mace for burst melee builds
recommendedUsage.lateGame: Still strong for PvP Greatsword builds and melee PvE
recommendedUsage.pvp: A-tier — attack speed compensates for slow heavy weapons, max HP wins trades
recommendedUsage.pve: A-tier — life leech sustains through long boss fights

bloodTypes.synergy: Attack speed steroid directly compensates for slow, heavy weapons. Life leech keeps you alive in melee range.

bloodTypes.name: Scholar

60.bonus: Spell power +15%, every 8th hit resets spell cooldowns

90.bonus: Spell power +20%, cooldown reset on 8th hit, free spell casts periodically

recommendedUsage.earlyGame: B-tier early — you don't have enough spells to benefit from cooldown reset
recommendedUsage.midGame: Becomes A-tier once you have 3+ spells — cooldown reset starts mattering
recommendedUsage.lateGame: S-tier for PvE — undisputed PvE meta with any fast-hitting weapon
recommendedUsage.pvp: C-tier — harder to consistently land 8 hits on human opponents
recommendedUsage.pve: S-tier — best PvE blood, cooldown reset makes it overpowered for mob and boss farming

bloodTypes.synergy: Cooldown reset on hit — more hits = more resets. Fast or multi-hit weapons maximize this. Reaper's wide AoE hits 3-5 enemies per swing, resetting cooldowns constantly.

bloodTypes.name: Rogue

90.bonus: Movement speed +15%, crit chance +15%, armor-expose on crit (20-30% defense reduction for 6s)

bloodTypes.bonusSummary: Armor-expose on crit + movement speed + crit chance

recommendedUsage.earlyGame: C-tier — armor-expose isn't available until 90%+ quality which is rare early
recommendedUsage.midGame: B-tier — movement speed is nice but other bloods offer more at this stage
recommendedUsage.lateGame: S-tier for PvP — armor-expose at 90%+ wins duels, dominates the PvP meta
recommendedUsage.pvp: S-tier — best PvP blood, armor-expose amplifies ALL damage by 20-30%
recommendedUsage.pve: B-tier — armor-expose is strong but Scholar's cooldown reset is better for PvE

bloodTypes.synergy: Armor-expose amplifies fast-hitting weapons. Flurry (Claws) hits 5-7 times in 1.5s — statistically at least one crit per use. Exposed armor = +20-30% damage from all sources for 6 seconds.

bloodTypes.name: Warrior

60.bonus: Physical damage +15%, 10% chance to block attacks

90.bonus: Physical damage +20%, 15% block chance, defense reduction on hit

bloodTypes.bonusSummary: Physical damage + block chance + defense reduction

recommendedUsage.earlyGame: A-tier — reliable physical damage boost works at any quality level
recommendedUsage.midGame: B-tier — solid but outshone by Brute (survival) and Scholar (cooldown)
recommendedUsage.lateGame: B-tier — defense reduction helps sustained DPS but burst meta favors other bloods
recommendedUsage.pvp: B-tier — solid frontline option, defense reduction beats tanky builds
recommendedUsage.pve: B-tier — physical damage boost is straightforward but lacks Scholar's multiplicative power

bloodTypes.synergy: Defense reduction for consistent melee DPS. Pairs best with sustained-damage weapons rather than burst weapons.

bloodTypes.name: Creature

60.bonus: Movement speed +10%, sun resistance +20%, health regen

90.bonus: Movement speed +15%, sun resistance +30%, strong health regen

bloodTypes.bonusSummary: Movement speed + sun resistance + health regen

recommendedUsage.earlyGame: B-tier — movement speed helps exploration, sun resistance is useful pre-horse
recommendedUsage.midGame: C-tier — utility only, outclassed by combat bloods once you have a horse
recommendedUsage.lateGame: D-tier — no combat value at endgame
recommendedUsage.pvp: D-tier — movement speed is irrelevant with mounts
recommendedUsage.pve: C-tier — utility pick for exploration, not for combat

bloodTypes.synergy: Movement speed and sun resistance — purely exploration utility. Swap to a combat blood before boss fights.

bloodTypes.name: Worker

recommendedUsage.earlyGame: C-tier — resource boost helps with early material grind
recommendedUsage.midGame: D-tier for combat — exclusively for resource farming
recommendedUsage.lateGame: D-tier for combat — swap via Blood Hunger before harvesting, then swap back
recommendedUsage.pve: D-tier for combat — not a combat blood, use only for farming resources

bloodTypes.synergy: Resource yield boost — not for combat builds. Best used via Blood Hunger: drain a Worker before harvesting nodes, then swap back to combat blood.

bloodTypes.name: Mutant

60.bonus: HP regen, damage resistance +10%, status effect duration -20%

90.bonus: HP regen, damage resistance +15%, status effect immunity

bloodTypes.bonusSummary: HP regen + damage resistance + status immunity

recommendedUsage.earlyGame: N/A — Mutant blood sources are in late-game Oakveil content
recommendedUsage.midGame: N/A — not accessible until Oakveil region
recommendedUsage.lateGame: C-tier — situational hybrid option, niche counter-pick for status-heavy fights
recommendedUsage.pvp: D-tier — outclassed by Rogue and Brute in their respective niches
recommendedUsage.pve: C-tier — status immunity is useful against specific bosses but Scholar is still better

bloodTypes.synergy: Status effect immunity — niche counter-pick against bosses with heavy status effects. Strong hybrid option but not best-in-class for any role.
